REF

REF believes that haircare and styling should be easy which is why each product is assigned three reference numbers defining the level of hold, shine & volume. Choosing the right product is as simple as deciding how much of these three aspects you want, and of course you can always ask a Bellezza professional for additional help in choosing the right reference for you.
